mutations.name: check-only CR (b): drop the AFTER-the-CR test on the cited run's completion (a run the reviewer already had when they blocked clears it — reddens TestCitedRunPredatesTheCR)
check-only CR (b): accept a cited run that did not finish green (the superseded FAILED run of a check that later went green clears the CR — reddens TestCitedRunNotGreen and TestCitedRunStillRunning)
check-only CR (c): read the exemption's rollup at a FIXED sha instead of the reviewed head (a run on another head becomes evidence about this one — reddens TestCitedRunNotAtHead)
check-only CR (d): drop the requirement that the cited run BE the check the CR named (any green run on the head clears any check-only CR — reddens TestCitedRunWrongCheck)
check-only CR: let a SHORT rollup read clear a standing rejection (the cited run may be in the part that was never served — reddens TestShortRollupReadRefuses)
